Name: Black Dress Shoes
Author: ChaoticSimpliciy
Description:
Reskin for the Space Boots because eww. The only other reskin for shoes did not have a nice plain black pair, so I made one to go with my suit :D

Installation instructions:
1: Extract contents of .rar
2: Make a backup of your original shoeColors.xnb  found in /content/characters/farmer (in case you need/want to revert to the original)
3: Copy new shoeColors.xnb to /content/characters/farmer
4: Enjoy

Downloads.Description: Simple reskin of the space boots to a nice black dress shoe.
